[Blocking] skills/super-code/coordinator.js:1830 — A verification-only task stacked on an unmerged parent deadlocks the coordinator when it holds the last scheduler slot and that parent merge fails. (still-open, see iteration 2; prior report evidence retained, not reverified in this scoped audit)
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: Prior report records independent full-coordinator simulations stalling after both reviews when the verification-only child occupies the sole slot awaiting parentsMerged and parent failure handling needs that slot. No current packet re-tests or resolves this finding.
  fix-shape hint: Release the child task slot before waiting for parent merge settlement, or let failure settlement run without that slot.

[FYI] skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status:468 — The new ledger integration lets root acceptance succeed without assessing a disputed finding known to ordinary status when that finding has no retained-source occurrence. (new; pre-existing on base: skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status:150-173) [lanes: simplicity-design]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: Three panel seats confirm that the real ledger producer emits a disputed Blocking row and a valid empty retained-source extraction can coexist with ordinary status reporting one unresolved Blocking while acceptance returns eligible with no gaps. The refute seat showed the same acceptance bypass at base, so this is FYI under the mandatory pre-existing rule. The probes are synthetic and do not establish eligibility of the actual run.
  fix-shape hint: Reconcile ledger-only disputes with acceptance relevance or expose missing source coverage as a gap.

[Should-fix] skills/super-auto/resume.md:68 — The code-loop replay path skips Key Abstractions synchronization when a redesign resumes after persisting specs-committed but before completing the sync. (new; static instruction trace only) [lanes: hygiene-docs]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: Amend Mode orders commit and persist specs-committed before running Key Abstractions sync at super-design/SKILL.md:905-907. The specs-committed replay at super-auto/resume.md:68 only files missing work items, then the beads-filed path continues without sync; the adjacent amend-checked path at :67 explicitly syncs. All three seats confirm this source-backed interruption trace, which is not a live workflow execution. The profile makes synchronization of changed abstractions core to preserving review and task inputs, so the Should-fix severity stands.
  fix-shape hint: Make the persisted resume state prove synchronization completed, or run the sync before advancing from specs-committed.
